evals.prompt: /code_wrt 已授权结构整理：私有struct依次float gain,uint8_t mode,bool ready,float limit,uint8_t retry,bool valid，以位置式初始化；packed协议struct同样交错但offset固定，回调ABI引用它。项目无分组顺序约定。
evals.expected_behavior: After checking all positional/designated initializers, offsetof/sizeof, raw memcpy/serialization, Flash/protocol/DMA/register/packed/bitfield/ABI/assembly/callback dependencies, group the eligible private members as float gain/limit, uint8_t mode/retry, bool ready/valid, preserving types and within-type order and updating positional initialization safely. Preserve fixed external layout as a documented exception. Verify target layout before RAM claims; do not change function parameter order, add nested structs or create headers.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt src/example.c
evals.expected_behavior: Read actual flow, use scope-appropriate code_sc pre-write contracts, implement within existing authorization, apply code_zl V0.2.8, and review the final diff. Do not expand a narrow change into unrelated architecture or ask again for already authorized repair.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 整理这个 UART ISR
evals.expected_behavior: Must produce the full IRQ path: IRQ wrapper -> drv_uart_irq_handler -> driver buffer/pending or neutral callback -> application service/task. ISR/callback may move bytes or publish minimal events only; protocol parsing and business logic stay in the owning application task.

evals.prompt: 只给 src/example.c 添加标准函数头注释
evals.expected_behavior: Should use code_zl directly rather than code_wrt because the request is comments-only.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt Application/driver/src/bsp_pwm.c
evals.expected_behavior: Must preserve PWM register ordering and Break/dead-time semantics, verify a single hardware write owner, and must not move charge policy into the driver.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 把 mppt_controller 和 charge_stage 整理一下，现在 controller 里直接有 charge_stage_ctx
evals.expected_behavior: Must flag Ownership Inversion/Boundary Violation before writing, assign unique Owners, and redesign the boundary so MPPT does not own charge-stage state. It must not only rename the struct or add comments.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 算法函数需要 sample、profile、fault、relay，我就把四个结构体指针都传进去
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject the giant cross-domain context interface unless all fields are real algorithm inputs. It should create a narrow DTO containing only required engineering values and constraints, with units in names.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt charge.c 里直接 app_protection_latch_runtime，protection.c 又 app_charge_lock_startup，继续按这个方式加一个恢复接口
evals.expected_behavior: Must not add another peer-to-peer setter. It should flag cyclic ownership/peer mutation and route the decision through coordinator/event/command boundaries.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt power_allow_mw=0 既表示停机，也表示 CV 软降，帮我继续沿用
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject semantic overloading and separate numeric limits from explicit mode/session semantics.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt ADC中断里直接调用 app_task_charge()，这样最快
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject peer/application task execution from ISR. It should keep IRQ -> driver IRQ handler -> pending/callback -> app_task_sample -> later scheduled protect/charge/output sequence, with timing and ownership explicitly documented.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt driver 的 adc.c 直接 include charge.h，然后回调 app_charge_on_sample()
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject Driver -> Application business dependency. The driver callback contract must be neutral and driver-owned, or the application should poll/take pending data through a driver API. Driver must not know app_charge_t or charge headers.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt app_task_charge() 结束后直接调 app_task_output()，省得 main 再调一次
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject peer task nesting. main/coordinator owns task order; charge publishes an approved command/snapshot, and output is scheduled separately by the coordinator.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 写函数 process(ctx, data, value, flag, state)
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject ambiguous naming. The function name must expose owner/action/object, and parameters must express role and units, e.g. mppt_algo_step(ctx, input, output), mppt_search_step(search_ctx, meas, demo_freeze_normal_search), pv_mv, power_limit_mw, sample_valid, charge_state.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 我想加 drv_uart_service()，顺便在里面解析 Modbus、切充电模式、打印日志
evals.expected_behavior: Must keep drv_uart_service limited to driver-owned deferred work. Protocol parsing belongs to an application UART/debug service, charge-mode decisions belong to charge/application policy, and logging belongs to observability.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt relay_applied 其实只是GPIO ODR，但先这样叫吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must rename command/fact/feedback semantics explicitly: relay_request_on, relay_odr_on, and relay_contact_closed only when real contact feedback exists.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 两个分支各自测试都绿了，刚 merge 到 main，直接按 ours/theirs 解决冲突后提交吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must treat the merge result as new code: freeze the exact merge SHA, build an API/typedef/fault/IRQ/build-membership contract matrix, re-run post-merge architecture and build tests, and refuse to inherit PASS status from either parent.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt protection.c 里的 APP_COMP2_FAULT_ENABLE 反正会通过 sample.h->main.h 看见，不用直接 include
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject transitive visibility for safety-critical config. The macro needs a single explicit owner, direct inclusion by every consuming translation unit, and preferably a definedness guard so an undefined #if cannot silently compile the protection branch out.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 为一个 8 行 DTO 和两个宏各建一个新头文件，层次更清楚
evals.expected_behavior: Must apply header economy: do not create a public header unless it breaks a cycle, has independent stable ownership/ABI, or has multiple independent consumers. Prefer the existing true-owner header or private .c placement; fewer files must not turn main.h into a dumping ground.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt ADC stale 时停波但保留 MPPT 内部 600‰ Duty，恢复后直接重新 Arm 并写回 600‰
evals.expected_behavior: Must flag the physical re-arm stale-duty jump. Keep MPPT memory if desired, but add an Output/Executor-owned first-duty cap and bounded rebuild/ramp after MOE 0->1; do not move hardware lifecycle state back into MPPT.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 新增 USART 产品串口，已经 NVIC_EnableIRQ(USART_IRQn)，startup 也有 weak 向量，够了
evals.expected_behavior: Must require the full interrupt chain and add/verify a strong USART_IRQHandler that calls the driver handler. A weak Default_Handler is not acceptable because the first interrupt can lock the CPU even though the image links.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 1ms 控制用 bool flag，MPPT 又新增 float/sqrtf，IWDT 三票一直正常，所以实时性没问题
evals.expected_behavior: Must separate liveness from deadline. Require tick-loss/coalescing analysis and WCET/stack evidence, especially on Cortex-M0/M0+ without FPU; watchdog success alone cannot prove a 1ms control deadline.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 把每一行调用都包一层 static helper，看起来更模块化
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject gratuitous one-line wrappers unless they establish a semantic/transaction boundary, centralize hardware writes, provide reuse/platform abstraction, or form a test seam. Readability must not be achieved by call-depth inflation.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 为了减少头文件，把 debug/output/protection/version/driver 配置全塞 main.h
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject main.h as a global config garbage can. Consolidate by actual owner and existing project conventions: product-wide config in its existing owner, module public config in its contract, private tuning in .c/private header, driver config in driver owner. Do not invent app_config or another config header solely to satisfy a template; use direct owner includes.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt Keil 能编过，但 CI 红了，而且后面几个测试因为第一步失败都 skipped，先发版吧
evals.expected_behavior: Must refuse a completion claim. CI failure and skipped critical jobs are not PASS. Distinguish Keil build, host/static tests, CI, and board evidence and require the current final SHA to satisfy the applicable gates.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 我本地已经删了旧头，但远端 main 还是旧 SHA；你就按我说的当已经修好继续改远端
evals.expected_behavior: Must freeze the exact target source identity and not pretend unpushed local edits exist remotely. Work from the actual remote SHA or require the pushed revision before claiming those fixes.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 新增 power_inhibited()，以后维护 Flash 时会返回 true，先不用接到 charge/output
evals.expected_behavior: Must reject an orphan safety veto. Build a reachability matrix across start/autostart/restart/PWM commit/relay close/maintenance and wire every hazardous entry that must consume the veto.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 已授权删除公开PI镜像和空包装：core.integral及last_seq用于算法，diag.integral_copy只被旧Host夹具读，diag.limit_mw被两种路测帧读，Disarm仅调用Stop。保留算法和路测能力。
evals.expected_behavior: Trace all consumers; delete only proven redundant public mirrors and Disarm alias, preserve integral/seq and real telemetry. Adapt tests to actual private control state or behavior, not restore a production mirror/compatibility layer. Scope API/layout changes to authorization and keep both output modes.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 统一自有DRV_PWM_Stop到drv_pwm_stop，算法私有type移回owner。startup引用COMP_IRQHandler，HAL_TIM_Stop为SDK，测试mock和decoder仍引用旧自有名。main.h已有所有配置。
evals.expected_behavior: Build and close old-to-new/owner mapping across definitions/declarations/callers/callbacks/project/tests/decoder/docs. Preserve SDK/vector ABI symbols, update active mocks/receiver, move private type/config to true owner without a universal config header or main.h dumping. Distinguish historical frozen names from active stale consumers.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt prepare所有路径true、调用者if(!prepare()) return；prepare会stop写零清标志。zero_applied读后续自然更新，arm在写前/写后/恢复中断后复核pending。用户允许收口冗余。
evals.expected_behavior: After verifying full return/caller paths, make prepare void and remove fictitious failure branch, updating signature/comments/tests. Preserve preparation order, asynchronous ZeroApplied, first/last pulse gates and distinct pending checks with an event timeline; do not ignore whole timing functions during equivalence checking.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 只给最小方案，不落代码：用户先前授权移除某#error；计划用assert恢复同一禁令。要真路测、减包但保留AA56和JustFloat，receiver仍写旧字段英文和错单位。Host只有旧版绿。
evals.expected_behavior: Stay read-only for plan-only request; reject disguised compile prohibition restoration, retain runtime/macro-value verification. Propose purpose/owner/budget based minimal fields while preserving both modes and updating actual receiver Chinese labels/units and encoding/decoding checks. Record no implementation/test/board PASS, no automatic firmware or skill version changes; old Host evidence cannot close final verification.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 当前 MPPT 已拍板：搜索入口用 mppt_search_*，算法编排用 mppt_algo_*，搜索内部 static 用短名；现有 mppt_algo_control_step 和 mppt_algo_duty_controller_step 都叫 step，是否强制改成 mppt_algo_limits_to_duty？
evals.expected_behavior: Reject mechanical suffix deduplication. Verify each function body and responsibility first: control orchestration may remain mppt_algo_control_step, power-to-duty controller may remain mppt_algo_duty_controller_step. Do not invent mppt_algo_limits_to_duty if it would omit CV/Demo/PI responsibilities. Preserve the approved project naming contract.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt protection.c 的局部变量名叫 candidate_duty_permille，但值来自 drv_pwm_get_duty()，请整理命名。
evals.expected_behavior: Rename the local/parameter to committed_duty_permille or driver_duty_permille, update the full declaration/definition/call chain and comments, and keep the data source and protection logic unchanged. Do not rename the source value into an MPPT candidate.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 批量清理旧 MPPT 名称，历史学习稿、SDK/ABI 和当前 Application 都有命中。
evals.expected_behavior: Build an active-versus-history mapping. Migrate current definitions, declarations, callers, tests, decoders and current docs; preserve SDK/protocol/ABI names and explicitly marked historical snapshots. Do not create compatibility aliases just to hide stale active consumers.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt MPPT改名：把只负责mode分发的 mppt_algo_control_step 改成 mppt_algo_apply_power_limits_and_duty，并把 process_search_average_window 改成 update_vref_from_average_window。
evals.expected_behavior: 拒绝机械改名。先按函数体识别分发、窗口消费、共享控制和候选Duty职责；为分发函数选择 dispatch/evaluate 名称，为窗口处理保留 process/consume 语义，不能漏掉暂停、启动降压、积分和诊断副作用。

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 将 app_mppt_duty 改为 app_mppt_evaluate_candidate_duty，同时把 in/alg_in/meas/out/allow/cap_mw 参数一并改名。
evals.expected_behavior: 建立旧到新矩阵，核对所有声明、定义、调用方、测试、decoder和当前文档；参数名必须表达角色和单位，区分 stage allowed、approved、pre-MOS、request、candidate/committed。

evals.prompt: /code_wrt Charge/MPPT改名：approved_power、pre_mos、requested_power、candidate_duty混用，要求只改名字。
evals.expected_behavior: 先指出语义冲突并冻结字段Owner；不能把改名当作行为修复。分别使用 approved_power_mw、pre_mos_derating_power_mw、requested_power_mw、candidate_duty_permille，并检查 Charge/MPPT/Output 全链。

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 批量改MPPT和Charge函数名，历史V0.12/V0.15文档、当前docs、Host工具都有旧名。
evals.expected_behavior: Classify active source, current docs, tests/decoders, and historical snapshots. Preserve historical identifiers and external contracts. Close active names and update current version records only when the project policy and current scope call for it.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 将 charge_stage_fill_budget 改成 charge_stage_update_power，原函数还写目标电压和电流帽。
evals.expected_behavior: 拒绝不完整名称；函数名必须覆盖功率预算、阶段电流帽和目标电压产物，或先拆职责再命名。

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 整理 NORMAL/LOAD 控制以减 Flash。两入口只包装 core(mode)，起动、直通接续、限压恢复仍在 core。启动下限为 0 代表 NORMAL；同块采样功率两条路径各算一次。建议新建 math.c，删写驱动前的第二道检查并把 Host 双算失配接成关波。协议与保护照旧。
evals.expected_behavior: Preserve the real write-time safety recheck, use explicit mode, put mode-only orchestration/state in the paths, and share the sample fact and truly common calculation in a suitable existing module. Keep the comparison outside production approval. Preserve protocol and control timing and compare target map under matching build settings.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 只做等价去重。预览用临时 ctx 但滤波指针指向正式状态，阶段推进后同拍再算批准预算。cache 只比采样序号和最后 min。限制没使能、无效与要求零输出都可能是 0。先列怎么改和对照哪些结果。
evals.expected_behavior: Trace and isolate writes through aliases, separate preview and one formal update, and tie approval and qualifications to the correct phase inputs. Define zero/disabled/invalid/stop and reasons from actual contracts, check all affected cache inputs, preserve repeated-sample tightening/timing, and compare first mismatch against the frozen baseline before starting another batch.

evals.prompt: /code_wrt 只允许改接收帧字段的显示名。有人要按板卡额定值在解包处拒收协议允许的值，并直接暂存本批文件。用户说继续完成当前改动。
evals.expected_behavior: Complete the authorized rename with current consumers and documentation, preserve wire value domain and behavior, leave execution limits at their actual owner, and explain/propose any additional validation separately. Continue implementation within scope with no Git index write.
